content.text: Found it — a dangling reference: `visit()` appends to the queue vector it is reading from. Let me fix:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='src/image_validate.cpp'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    bool visit(const Work& w);","    bool visit(Work w);")
s=s.replace("bool Validator::visit(const Work& w) {","bool Validator::visit(Work w) {   /* by value: visit() appends to the queue */")
# restore the simple alignment check
s=s.replace("""    if ((w.depth - w.origin) % 6 != 0) {
        scamp_validate_error = "align depth=" + std::to_string(w.depth) + " origin=" +
            std::to_string(w.origin) + " stage=" + std::to_string(s) + " cell=" + std::to_string(w.cell);
        return false;
    }""","""    if ((w.depth - w.origin) % 6 != 0) return FAILAT();""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 build.py 2>&1|tail -2 && python3 tmp/dev/t1.py 2>&1 | tail -20
